items.a: Yes — ApplyOS is free on the App Store. Profiling, search, matching and pipeline are all included with no cost.

items.q: Where do the listings come from?
items.a: Listings come from one of Germany's largest job databases, with hundreds of thousands of live roles.

items.q: Can I apply directly from the app?
items.a: ApplyOS hands you off to the original listing where you apply directly. The app can generate a tailored cover letter for you first.

items.q: What's the psychology profiling for students?
items.a: Students go through a scientifically grounded personality assessment. Based on the results, the app suggests fitting apprenticeships or study programs.

items.q: Is my data shared with companies?
items.a: No. ApplyOS has no corporate clients. Your data is yours — never sold, never shared.

items.q: How current are the listings in the app?
items.a: ApplyOS sources roles directly from one of Germany's largest job databases — updated daily, with hundreds of thousands of active listings.

items.q: How does the AI matching work?
items.a: Instead of keyword filters, ApplyOS analyzes your profile holistically — values, strengths, life stage, experience. From that, it computes a match score per role so you see at a glance how well it fits.

items.q: Are application docs really generated automatically?
items.a: Yes. CV and cover letter are personalized per role with one tap — you don't have to start from scratch each time.

items.q: Can I apply directly from the app?
items.a: ApplyOS hands you off to the company's original listing, where you apply directly. Privacy is preserved and you keep a direct line to the employer.

items.q: How is the Kanban pipeline different from Notion or LinkedIn?
items.a: It's purpose-built for applications — with stages Discovered, Applied, Interview, Offer — and stays in sync with your app actions automatically. No manual upkeep, no foreign fields.

items.q: What happens to my CV data?
items.a: Your data stays yours. ApplyOS has no corporate clients — no profile is sold, no CV passed to recruiters.

items.q: Am I too young for ApplyOS?
items.a: ApplyOS makes sense from age 14. If you're still in school, you go through an age-appropriate personality profiling and get suggestions for apprenticeships or study programs — no job listings.

items.q: How scientific is the profiling really?
items.a: The profiling builds on established personality models (Big Five, RIASEC) and was developed with psychologists. No magic, no gut-feeling tests — methods validated in research for decades.

items.q: Does the app also help with apprenticeship applications?
items.a: Yes. After profiling, ApplyOS guides you step by step through every application — from the cover letter and interview prep to tracking where you've already applied.

items.q: What do my parents or teachers see in the app?
items.a: Nothing — unless you share it. ApplyOS is your private app. Profiling results, suggestions and applications are visible only to you.

items.q: Is my data shared with schools or advisors?
items.a: No. ApplyOS has no institutional clients — neither schools nor career advisors get access to your data.

items.q: What if the app suggests an apprenticeship I don't like?
items.a: Then you dismiss the suggestion and give feedback — the app learns from that and refines its picks. You always decide what fits — not the algorithm.
